description: Fortune teller: ask a yes-or-no question and get one of the 20 classic Magic 8-Ball answers, chosen at random (Signs point to yes, Very doubtful, and so on). A light fortune-telling novelty for games and chat bots, not a prediction. Use when you want a playful fortune or an 8-ball answer. Example: question=Will it ship today?. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
